regime_read: The pack shows a bias toward pro-cyclical tech/hardware and government-exposed names, but most clusters are driven by one or two channels rather than genuine multi-source alignment. SMCI is the only flagged-extended name and must be avoided; the few coherent reads are slow-burn accumulation candidates, not momentum chases.
regime_read_zh: 证据包偏向顺周期科技/硬件和政府相关标的，但多数簇仅由一两个渠道驱动，而非真正的多源共振。SMCI 是唯一被标记为超涨的标的，必须回避；少数连贯的解读是缓慢累积型候选，而非追逐动量的机会。

theses.thesis: MU shows the most balanced convergence in the pack: congress_cluster (net buy 6, 3 members) aligns with insider_mspr at 100 and a patent_cluster (424 patents), while stocktwits_bull is maxed [congress_cluster, insider_mspr, patent_cluster, stocktwits_bull]. The -6.6% 60d relative print means it has lagged the tape, so no extended-entry problem. Earnings in 16 days (Sep-30) with a prior 18.6% surprise is the near-term catalyst; the second-order AI-memory/hardware complex is the multi-quarter driver.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 呈现本包中最为均衡的共振：国会簇（净买入 6，3 名议员）与内部人 mspr 100、专利簇（424 项）相互印证，同时 stocktwits 看多处于极值 [congress_cluster, insider_mspr, patent_cluster, stocktwits_bull]。60 日相对表现为 -6.6%，说明其落后于大盘，不存在超涨入场问题。16 天后（9 月 30 日）财报，此前有 18.6% 的超预期记录，构成近期催化；AI 存储/硬件复合体是跨季度驱动。
second_order: AMAT — semiconductor-capital-equipment supplier benefits from memory capex [analyst_upgrade_cluster, congress_cluster]
NVDA — shared AI/hardware momentum and analyst upgrade alignment [analyst_upgrade_cluster, github_momentum]
Hynix/Samsung (unlisted) — memory-peer read-through from MU's pricing cycle
theses.dissent: Insider mspr of 100 can reflect a scheduled or automated program rather than discretionary conviction, and congressional buying in a memory name is historically noisy — the alignment may be incidental.

falsifier.text: MU guides significantly below consensus on Sep-30 or patent/congress flows reverse without a matching price recovery within 60 days

theses.thesis: BAH is the cleanest pure-play government-contract acceleration read: gov_contract_accel of 3.79 on $56M/30d flows, plus special_situation and a trump-linked buy side [gov_contract_accel, special_situation, trump]. Only a 1.3% 60d relative print means there is no crowding; the trade is one of gradual flow recognition rather than an explosive repricing. Conviction stays low because two channels are soft/contextual and the track record is empty.
theses.thesis_zh: BAH 是最干净的纯政府合同加速标的：30 日 5608 万美元流入、加速率 3.79，叠加特殊事件与特朗普关联买入标签 [gov_contract_accel, special_situation, trump]。60 日相对表现仅 1.3%，说明没有拥挤；该交易属于渐进式流量确认，而非爆发式重定价。由于两个渠道偏软/情境化且历史战绩为空，信心保持低位。
second_order: LDOS/CACI (unlisted) — defense-services peers likely sharing the classified-contract tailwind
theses.dissent: A 3.79x acceleration on a modest dollar base can be a single delayed award or quarterly timing; without a follow-on print the signal decays quickly.

falsifier.text: Next 30d government-contract print drops below 1x acceleration or BAH reports a sequential bookings decline

theses.thesis: SMCI is flagged extended (+35.1% 60d vs SPY) and its cluster is low-convergence: insider_mspr of 30.2 is weak, retail_buzz is high but momentum-driven, and unusual_options shows a 0.29 put/call skew that reads more as speculative call-chasing than informed accumulation [insider_mspr, retail_buzz, unusual_options]. theses.thesis_zh: SMCI 被标记为超涨（60 日相对 SPY +35.1%），且其簇收敛度低：内部人 mspr 仅 30.2，零售热度高但属于动量驱动，异常期权 0.29 的 put/call 更偏向投机性追涨而非知情吸纳 [insider_mspr, retail_buzz, unusual_options]。按照交易台规则，超涨且缺乏真正多源对齐的标的一律回避。
theses.dissent: If the AI-server building block cycle accelerates again, SMCI's options skew could prove early — but that is a momentum call, not an alt-data convergence read.

falsifier.text: No material insider buying or fundamental contract/patent signal emerges despite continued retail buzz within 30 days

theses.thesis: MRK clusters on clinical/fda channels (11 phase-3 starts, fda_label_expansion) plus a trump buy side, but the clinical_halts count of 4 is the dissenting data point inside the same evidence [clinical_phase3_start, fda_label_expansion, special_situation, trump]. The 22.8% 60d relative move is firm but not yet extended; this is a watch for pipeline conversion into regulatory milestones rather than a fresh accumulation.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK 在临床/FDA 渠道上形成簇（11 项三期启动、FDA 标签扩展），叠加特朗普买入标签，但同一证据内部存在 4 项临床暂停这一反面信号 [clinical_phase3_start, fda_label_expansion, special_situation, trump]。60 日相对上涨 22.8% 稳健但尚未超涨；这适合作为管转监管里程碑的观察项，而非新建仓累积。
second_order: ABBV — shared clinical_phase3_start / fda_label_expansion catalyst pattern in large-cap pharma
theses.dissent: Four clinical halts inside the same window undercut the bullish phase-3 count; pipeline attrition is the core risk and the trump-side label is a weak edge.
